shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json AGENTS.md; ls -R .agents | head -50

ls src; cat src/*; cat index.html; rg -n -i -C 4 "dropdown|menu" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button Icon ThemeProvider
bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit DropdownMenu Button 2>&1 | head -60; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>&1 | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && ls build/esm/components/DropdownMenu; cat build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; cat ../icons/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls ../icons/ | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu && cat DropdownMenu.d.ts; ls ../../../../../icons | grep -E "^(Ellipsis|Pencil|Copy|TrashBin|ChevronDown|Gear)\.d\.ts"; grep -n "extends\|hasArrow" ../Menu/Menu.d.ts | head
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm install @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 --save-exact 2>&1 | tail -5; grep -n gravity package.json
